theme: Last day ashore before the charter.
greeting: A quiet, open day in Dubrovnik, Dan — the girls are with Jen. It's your last full day on land before the Nautilus charter boards tomorrow afternoon, so the short list below is the handful of loops worth closing while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers before Saturday
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Komolac to Cavtat transfer, a bag hold at Remisens, and the early Sept 20 checkout all need arranging from dry land — charter connectivity is poor to nonexistent once you board tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Provision in Dubrovnik today
needsAttention.detail: Cash, snacks, alcohol and any gluten-free items ahead of the ~5 PM Saturday boarding; Studenac, Tommy and Konzum are the closest stores.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with the instructor
needsAttention.detail: Nail down Saturday's meeting time and place plus the Sept 19 return transfer; Amy's 'Have a Great Sailing Trip' note landed this morning if you need her contact.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20 to Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV out of TPA is now a firm booking rather than a hedge — do it while you have signal, not walk-up and jet-lagged on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Send Kerrie the AI paper
needsAttention.detail: Kerrie Waring asked for the AI governance paper you'd mentioned; a quick send closes it before you go dark for the week.

flagged.title: New VP Government Affairs roles
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged openings similar to the Macy's VP, Government Affairs posting.

flagged.title: Lubrano still wants a call
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano's Nomura / Japan intermediaries thread is waiting on a time from you.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and receipts — NYT Cooking, Monocle, Responsible Investor, Italian word of the day, booking confirmations.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply.

resolved.title: Carol Hansell call parked until you're back
resolved.detail: You replied and she wrote back 'happy sailing, let's talk when you're back' — nothing owed now.

resolved.title: Cavtat hotel confirmed
resolved.detail: Remisens Hotel Epidaurus is booked and paid for Sept 19 (conf 5547387205).

recipe.title: Translucent Apple Tart
recipe.why: Early-autumn apples are at their crispest now, ideal for a tart that leans on the fruit itself.

acts.line: An open morning in the Old Town — nothing on the calendar.
The ashore errands cluster here: provisioning and the Cavtat transfers to lock before the boat.
Last night on land; the charter boards tomorrow afternoon and connectivity thins from there.
